text:
Dana (AE): Maya asked us to finalize POC acceptance gates before EOD. Summary of customer asks:
- 4-week sandbox, production-like traffic
- p95 latency target, cost cap per 1M reqs, and quality parity with their current model
- KMS + SSO + audit logs required for kickoff

Rex (SE): quick Qs: what's their traffic profile (sustained vs burst) and typical seq lengths? need golden prompt set for quality gate.

Maya (Buyer): traffic: sustained ~22 qps, short bursts to 75 qps (1-5 min), avg input 110 tokens, avg output 90 tokens, rare long contexts to 1200 tokens. Monthly projection ~1.15M req-equivalents. We'll upload a 150-example golden set.

Ike (Eng): recommendation: start with a 48h hosted canary replay, then switch traffic to a 1-node dedicated pool with burst autoscale. We'll provide both fp16 and 8-bit quantized runs for cost/quality comparison. Auto-fallback to baseline ensemble if any gate trips.

Rex (SE): proposed acceptance gates:
1) Performance: p95 <= 270ms measured over a 48h canary with the agreed traffic replay; error rate <0.5%.
2) Cost: modeled monthly burn <= $360 per 1M request-equivalents (we'll include tokenization math + hosted vs dedicated scenarios).
3) Quality: golden-set F1 drop <= 1.5% and top-3 accuracy within 0.03 of their baseline. Quantized variant must meet the same thresholds.

Dana (AE): security/compliance gate: customer CMK support in KMS (or Redwood-managed with BYOK option), SAML SSO, and audit-log retention policy (90 days). security-bot please attach SOC2 excerpt and KMS wiring doc.

security-bot: attached: soc2-summary.pdf, kms-wiring-diagram.svg :white_check_mark:

Ike (Eng): perf test plan (short):
```
profile: mixed
sustained_qps: 22
peak_qps: 75
p50_seq_len: 160
p95_seq_len: 820
duration: 3h
metrics: p50,p95,p99,errors,token_burn
```
We'll run fp16 and 8-bit runs; primary gate uses p95.

Rex (SE): rollback & notification: if p95 > threshold for 10 continuous minutes OR error_rate >0.5% for 5 minutes -> shift to baseline model, page oncall: Ike -> Rex -> Dana. MTTR target 30m. I'll add runbook snippet to the acceptance doc.

Maya (Buyer): for the cost gate we need explicit sensitivity to batching window (0ms, 10ms, 25ms) and to quantization path. Also need clear RAG data retention policy for sandbox indices.

Ike (Eng): will include a sensitivity table and a short RAG retention appendix (sandbox index retention 14 days by default, options to extend). Also pricing scenarios: hosted PAYG and dedicated reserved (1 node + burst).

Dana (AE): action items & timeline:
- Today EOD: Maya uploads golden-set; security-bot confirms SOC2/KMS docs.
- +24h: Rex runs canary replay and posts perf numbers (p95 + token burn + quantized comparison).
- +36h: Ike posts cost scenarios and reserved node config.
- +48-72h: finalize acceptance doc and schedule 30-min sign-off with Maya.
Owners: Rex (tests & runbook), Ike (infra & cost), Dana (acceptance doc & customer comms).

Maya (Buyer): thanks, please make the acceptance doc explicit about rollback contacts and expected SLAs during the sandbox. We'll review after the perf run. :thumbsup:
